units.source_text: 柏木比夕雾年长五六岁，然而还是翩翩少年，姿态娇艳可爱。

en.t: Kashiwagi was five or six years older than Yugiri, yet he was still a graceful young man, charming and lovely in bearing.

units.source_text: 夕雾则威严堂皇，有男子气概，不过相貌也很柔嫩清秀，远胜常人。

en.t: Yugiri, on the other hand, was dignified and imposing, with a manly spirit; yet his features too were tender and refined, far surpassing ordinary people.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女目送夕雾出门，哀情也稍稍忘怀了。

en.t: As the young gentlewomen watched Yugiri go out, they forgot their sorrow a little.

units.source_text: 夕雾看见庭前一树樱花开得非常美丽，想起“今岁应开墨色花”的古歌。

en.t: Seeing a cherry tree before the garden blooming with extraordinary beauty, Yugiri recalled the old poem, "This year it should bloom with flowers the color of ink."

units.source_text: 觉得此诗不祥，便信口吟唱另一首古歌：

en.t: Feeling that this poem was ill-omened, he casually chanted another old poem:

units.source_text: “年年春至群花放，能否看花命听天。”

en.t: "Year after year, when spring arrives, all the flowers bloom; whether we may see them is a matter of life entrusted to heaven."
Then he composed a poem and said:
